source: ZXNAME0000XZ's legacy torch.ao.quantization APIs still expose min/max, moving-average, per-channel, and histogram observers. Current quantization development is centralized in torchao; the exact calibration strategy used by an ZXNAME0001XZ method can be more specialized.
zh: ZXNAME0000XZ 的旧版 torch.ao.quantization API 仍然公开最小/最大、移动平均、每通道和直方图观察器。目前量化开发集中在torchao； ZXNAME0001XZ 方法使用的精确校准策略可以更加专门化。
